change_scope: Route-local scheduling prevents an independent audit provider's keyed queue from idling another provider.
Explicit remaining-role selection references closed prior consumption instead of repeating any sent request.
Unique coverage and actual usage are reconciled across immutable phases.
unchanged_science: Every original admitted DEV and original-cross source view and task/package digest
Every original A/B auditor prompt, including the bounded historical-context amendment
Frozen production parsing, both eligibility gates and one-to-one causal-key matching
The same native auditor routes and fixed Sonnet union scorer
Invocation controls, native attestation, admission threshold and missingness of actually sent failures
cross_policy: Preserve every existing/consumed cross output and attempt unchanged, with no retry. A separate stage continuation may finish only never-sent roles from the SAME original15 cases under the identical original source, prompts, gates, scorer and hash-bound scorer-only cache. No new key set or source labels are admitted. Original v4 cross metrics remain separately reported.
prior_close_barrier: Actual preparation requires the registered v4 cutoff to have passed and every initialized v4 worker to be finished; the integration owner also verifies native consumers stopped.

selection.basis: Consumption and finalization metadata only, never observed quality or matched-key labels.
selection.new_audit: No original audit receipt, consumption marker or owned native artifact exists.
selection.scorer_only_resume: An isolated attested audit answered, no terminal cell exists, and the scorer has no consumed native attempt. Reuse the exact audit bytes; dispatch only the still-unsent scorer.
selection.prior_terminal: Any already-finalized cell or actually-consumed refusal, transport error, malformed answer, quarantine, orphaned attempt or scorer failure stays terminal and is not rerun.
selection.unavailable_input: Frozen source-unavailable original cases stay represented and unattemptable; no new source or key intake is used to repair their mismatches.
selection.partition: Each route plan represents every original case of its explicit DEV or original-cross stage. Each arm partitions them exactly into remaining actions and referenced prior-terminal/unavailable slots. Unequal remaining A/B cohorts are allowed only with bound prior-consumption proof.

scheduler.admission: Fresh complete native account/all-window metadata strictly below90% before every new auditor or scorer request.
scheduler.checkpoint_policy: A future checkpoint closes only that immutable phase. It does not authorize reducing ALL-DEV scope; remaining unsent work continues disjointly through natural subscription windows until delivered or a genuine resource blocker is established.

accounting.unique_attempt_identity: Canonical resolved native request directory and its bound receipt/consumption artifacts, not the number of cells or symlinks referencing it.
accounting.cached_auditor_origin: The original phase retains its call, tokens and attestation; a new phase may add only an unsent scorer.
accounting.quality: One authoritative quality row per exact model/arm/task; phase metrics and unique-union metrics are both retained.
accounting.ab_comparison: Same-route shared-complete-cell intersection with exact task/key denominators.
accounting.acceptance: All399 represented/prepared tasks, actual active-model/arm audit attempts, answers, fully scored cells and auditor/scorer unsent backlog are separate. Disabled catalog candidates and null full-cohort quality metrics alone do not determine delivery coverage.
accounting.unknown_usage: Null with explicit known lower bounds; never zero-imputed.

frozen_prerequisite: Route protocol/plan, prior-consumption snapshot, actual source/runtime/input pins and code digests are recorded before any continuation dispatch. A no-provider actual-constructor/science-loader preflight must pass first.
